preconditions.description: The number of tournaments n is between 1 and 50,000 inclusive.
The number of kinds of sport k is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sij <= 10**9 for sij in [sij for si in powers for sij in si])
preconditions.description: Each sportsman's power in each kind of sport sij is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of power lists matches the number of tournaments n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(si) == k for si in powers)
preconditions.description: Each power list contains exactly k powers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(si)) == k for si in powers)
preconditions.description: All powers for each sportsman in each kind of sport are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers, one for each tournament.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= oi <= i + 1 for i, oi in enumerate(output))
postconditions.description: Each output number oi for the i-th tournament is between 1 and i+1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(oi, int) for oi in output)
postconditions.description: Each output number oi is an integer.
